{{Quote|Get out of the way, all of you! I'm having a serious malfunction!|This droid talking to his squad.|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and participated in a [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]].

==History==
During the battle, this droid along with the rest of his squad started to fire on three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], forcing them to seek cover. Later, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to lift this droid up and used it to fire upon the rest of its squad. The droid was then destroyed by the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
